scope: LOO empirical calibration of frozen z-resolved wake matched filter
resolution_note: With 120 mocks the minimum p+1 is 1/121=0.00826446; the empirical calibration therefore cannot resolve a smaller tail probability.
analysis_scope: Each leave-one-out mock score uses the remaining N-1 realizations, while the data score uses all N. Empirical tail probabilities are calculated with the +1 finite-sample correction.
